camel_example: aliyun smartag ListDpiGroups --region cn-hangzhou --DpiGroupIds.1 'example-string' --DpiGroupNames.1 'example-string' --NextToken FFPSpX59Eb0000 --MaxResults 3 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --version 2018-03-13 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the application groups supported by Smart Access Gateway in a specified region
description_zh: 查询指定地域下智能接入网关支持的应用组信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag list-dpi-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token FFPSpX59Eb0000 --max-results 3 --dpi-group-ids example-string --dpi-group-names example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDpiGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the regions supported by Smart Access Gateway and their corresponding region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions查询智能接入网关支持的地域及对应的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to start the next query
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of application groups returned per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 列表分页查询时每页展示的应用组个数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the application groups. You can specify one or more application group IDs to query their information. You can query up to 10 application groups at a time
parameters.help_zh: 应用组ID列表。您可以通过应用组ID指定查询一个或多个应用组的信息，一次最多可查询10个指定的应用组
parameters.name: dpi_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The names of the application groups. You can specify one or more application group names to query their information. You can query up to 10 application groups at a time
parameters.help_zh: 应用组名称列表。您可以通过应用组名称指定查询一个或多个应用组的信息，一次最多可查询10个指定的应用组
parameters.name: dpi_group_names

DpiGroupId.description_en: The ID of the application group

DpiGroupName.description_en: The name of the application group

MinEngineVersion.description_en: The minimum DPI engine version that supports the application group
MinEngineVersion.description_zh: 支持该应用组的最低引擎版本

MinSignatureDbVersion.description_en: The minimum signature database version that supports the application group
MinSignatureDbVersion.description_zh: 支持该应用组的最低特征库版本

NextToken.description_en: The token that is used to start the next query

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of application groups returned by the current query
TotalCount.description_zh: 当前查询返回的应用组总数
